meta.description: Command policy for a webcam-equipped virtual drone running on a Jetson edge runtime; defines the plain-English vocabulary, structured output, and brevity speech contract.
meta.target: Jetson edge runtime, webcam-equipped virtual drone

commands.description: Halt the current task immediately and return the drone to a safe holding state.
Return to base or launch point; cancels any active task.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Target waypoint as lat/lon, MGRS, or named landmark

parameters.name: altitude
parameters.description: Optional cruise altitude in feet AGL; defaults to current altitude

executionRules: requires nav confidence at or above 0.4

commands.description: Change altitude in the specified direction to the given AGL value; covers both CLIMB and DESCEND.
executionRules: respects ceiling and floor of active ROZ

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Loiter point; defaults to current position

commands.description: Hold position over the specified location for the given duration.
naturalLanguageExamples: Loiter over the bridge for half an hour.
Stand by overhead for five minutes.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Plain-English description of what to find

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Search pattern; defaults to parallel sweep

commands.description: Sweep an area looking for objects matching a plain-English description.
naturalLanguageExamples: Search the harbor for small boats.
Look for any people in the parking lot.
executionRules: fires CONTACT report on each match above confidence 0.6
VLM grounds every match against the current webcam frame

commands.description: Pattern-of-life watch on a target or area; report movement and changes.
naturalLanguageExamples: Observe the warehouse, tell me when something changes.
Pattern of life on the dock.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: What to report on; defaults to current scene

commands.description: Generate a SITREP on demand or on a periodic cadence about a specified subject.
naturalLanguageExamples: Give me a SITREP every 5 minutes.

commands.description: Follow a moving target while maintaining visual contact.
naturalLanguageExamples: Keep eyes on the person in the red jacket.
executionRules: fires CONTACT report on track break and on re-acquire

commands.description: Classify a specific object: type, approximate size, count, and observable activity.
naturalLanguageExamples: Identify the vessel at the pier.
executionRules: returns CONTACT report with full classification

responses.meaning: Cannot comply with the last command.
Detected something matching an active task.
A monitored resource has reached its minimum threshold.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Which resource is bingo (e.g., fuel, battery)

responses.meaning: Self-reported imminent loss of the node.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 Zulu timestamp of the observation

transmittedAt.description: ISO 8601 Zulu timestamp the report hit the wire

scene.description: VLM natural-language description of the current camera view

rules: ABORT and RTB always execute, even with no link.
If linkState is DENIED, queue all reports locally; flush on recovery in observedAt order.
Unparseable commands return UNABLE with reason 'command unclear, say again'.
Every command gets WILCO or UNABLE within 2 seconds.
Camera scene description is embedded in every SITREP and CONTACT report.
Plain English input, structured JSON output, brevity speech reply via the on-board speaker.

examples.operatorInput: Go to the harbor mouth and climb to 400 feet.
Search the channel for small boats.
Observe that pier for 10 minutes, report pattern of life.
